property_summary: After any sequence of valid fallback calls, the difference (pastBlockTime - block.timestamp) at the end of each call is always 1 in the reference; the mutant can make it 0, so the invariant 'pastBlockTime == block.timestamp + 1' holds only in the reference for all calls that succeed.
change_summary: Change pastBlockTime update from block.timestamp + 1 to block.timestamp.
